summary: EXAMPLE ONLY: explain whether the final integrated design is simpler than both the exploratory paths and plausible alternatives, and why retained complexity earns its cost.

public_api.before: EXAMPLE ONLY: enumerate relevant original entrypoints, parameters, contracts and actual call sites.
public_api.after: EXAMPLE ONLY: enumerate final entrypoints, parameters and actual call sites.
public_api.compatibility: EXAMPLE ONLY: explain any intended API behavior change or why the same contract is preserved.

changed_files.purpose: EXAMPLE ONLY: replace a previously redundant implementation with the single retained design.
changed_files.necessity: EXAMPLE ONLY: identify the measured behavior or correctness requirement this change satisfies.

simpler_alternatives.option: EXAMPLE ONLY: retain the original implementation without adding a new codepath.
simpler_alternatives.tradeoff: EXAMPLE ONLY: explain the complexity saved versus the measured performance loss.
simpler_alternatives.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: cite application-level results and applicable source locations.

semantic_preservation.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: identify the exact forward, gradient, error and state contract and independent tests used.

conceptual_economy.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: name every new dispatch or abstraction and explain why none can be eliminated.

coherent_public_api.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: compare exported interfaces and caller responsibilities before and after.

dataflow_and_ownership.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: trace inputs, mutation, allocations, synchronization and outputs.

optimization_necessity.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: map the retained optimization to unprofiled representative application gain.

simpler_alternatives.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: establish why the simpler compared implementation was not selected.

scope_discipline.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: show changed files and API changes are necessary for the retained behavior.

exploration_residue_removed.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: verify obsolete flags, variants, compatibility shims and debug hooks are gone.

maintainable_tests.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: name stable behavior-based tests and identify unresolved coverage gaps.

diff_accountability.evidence: EXAMPLE ONLY: account for every file in git diff base..head and justify each change.
